title: MV STREET FIGHTING STYLE PLUGIN SET UP

posts.author: SHA4ZA
posts.body:
Hello! This is my first post on a thread so I hope i set it up well
i have a question about making a side view street fight style game, the game would be set as a side scroller and the fights that woul'd occasionally happen would be set on a seperete map made for that purpose. It'd use the most basic functions of an ABS plugin that'd include, block, basic triple click combo and MAYBE a singular skill. but not items or different skills. It'd have an HP and Stamina bar. As hit box i meant here the direction of the character hitting. The blue character would be thee player and the red one would be the event. The ABS plugin would only be active on this mapdedicated to the fight
The Charcters would only face one direction, moving back would be walking back facing the opponent (event) the hits would be on the player facing always left, no matter if he's moving back or forward. The original ABS sword animation would be replaced by a hit. Both Fighters would move rather slow. The basic mechnics of the game would be easy and overall the fights themsleves would be easy and would rely on how well you time blocks and use stamina as fighting would be not the main part of the game but an aspect.

Speaking from experience, RPG Maker is not good for this kind of fast paced action gameplay, any general purpose engine can do it better, easier and faster. The RPG Maker devs even have their own separate engines for it if you want to support them (Pixel Game Maker and Action Game Maker).
